message.reasoning_content:
The image shows a Rolex Submariner Date, black dial, black ceramic bezel (Cerachrom), stainless steel Oyster bracelet. The dial text: "ROLEX OYSTER PERPETUAL DATE", "SUBMARINER 1000ft=300m SUPERLATIVE CHRONOMETER OFFICIALLY CERTIFIED". The date at 3 o'clock with cyclops lens. The case size — likely 41mm (126610LN) or 40mm (116610LN). The proportions... The maxi dial with larger hour markers, "Swiss Made" at bottom with the crown between. The lugs look relatively slim, which suggests 126610LN (41mm). The bracelet looks like it has the wider clasp. Hard to distinguish 116610LN vs 126610LN. The lugs on the 126610LN are slimmer than the 116610LN's fat lugs. In this photo, the lugs appear fairly slim/tapered → 126610LN.

Let me look: the case sides look slimmer, with less boxy shoulders. I'd guess 126610LN. Also the "Swiss Made" with crown at 6 o'clock. Both have this. The bezel numerals — both similar.

Reference number 126610LN for stainless steel black dial Submariner Date 41mm.

Movement: automatic (Calibre 3235). Case material stainless steel, bracelet metal. Confidence ~0.7.

Actually, distinguishing: the 116610LN has wider lugs and the bracelet is 20mm at lugs. The 126610LN has 21mm. Hard. The date window font: 126610LN date wheel is the same. The crown guard shape... In the photo the crown guards look somewhat slim, tapering.

Also, note the dial text spacing on 116610LN vs 126610LN is same. I'll go with 126610LN, confidence 0.65.
